baseline_source: Fresh extraction of the attached archive into a disposable project copy; paper builds never run on the delivery tree.
environment_notes: TMPDIR points to a writable directory outside artifact, preventing tempfile fallback into the checked source tree.
Clang 19.1.7 comes from verified official Debian packages; its binary SHA-256 equals the retained tool identity.
TeX format and font maps were generated in a user-local tree from official Debian packages.
Times New Roman files and installer archive match Debian ttf-mscorefonts-installer 3.8.1 checksums; binaries are not redistributed.
